?

A=[−122131341],B=[−7−62−2−11001]

By applying elementary column operations of the form Ci:=Ci+kC3, the matrix A can be transformed into the matrix B. What are the elementary column operations?

a
C1:=C1−4C3 and C2:=C2−3C3
b
C1:=C1−3C3 and C2:=C2+C3
c
C1:=C1−3C3 and C2:=C2−4C3
d
C1:=C1+4C3 and C2:=C2−3C3
e
C1:=C1−3C3 and C2:=C2+4C3
